title: Part 5
content_zh: The art of war teaches us to rely not on the likelihood of the enemy not coming, but on our own readiness to receive him. Not on the chance of him not attacking, but on the fact that we have made our position unassailable.
content_en: The art of war teaches us to rely not on the likelihood of the enemy not coming, but on our own readiness to receive him. Not on the chance of him not attacking, but on the fact that we have made our position unassailable.
